findings.evidence: `git diff --stat 9e33ac9 5ce5d22 -- '*.test.ts' '*.test.tsx'` is empty: the Step 2 UI commit adds no tests, and the Vitest total stays at 50 files / 415 tests (identical to Step 1). No test covers the BROADCAST option, the PICKUP-only rerun checkbox and its reset on type change, rerun/BROADCAST badges, or the R33 migration error message.
findings.impact: Acceptance criterion Step 2 item 4 (tests for BROADCAST option, rerun toggle visibility/reset, badge rendering and unapplied-migration error copy) is not met, so regressions in the new form state and payload rules would go undetected.
findings.recommendation: Add tests to the listed Step 2 test files: admin page and RequestSubmissionModal (BROADCAST option present; rerun checkbox shown only for PICKUP; switching away resets it; payload includes is_rerun only per rule; 42703/PGRST204/23514 shows the R33 message), hero-sidebar/weekly-schedule-list/games ScheduleTree/desktop-calendar (특별방송 label and 복각 badge).

findings.evidence: Edit payloads always send `is_rerun: false` when the checkbox is off (`editingScheduleId ? { is_rerun: false } : {}`); the same pattern is in `src/components/game/request-submission-modal.tsx:263` for EDIT requests.
findings.impact: Until the R33 migration is applied, every admin schedule edit and every user schedule-edit request fails with PGRST204 because the column does not exist, even for schedules that never had a rerun flag. This contradicts AC Step 2 item 3 (include is_rerun only when true) and blocks unrelated edits during the deploy-to-migration window.
findings.recommendation: Send `is_rerun: false` only when the edited source schedule had `is_rerun === true` (track the loaded value), otherwise omit the key; keep sending `true` when checked. Add a test for both branches.

findings.evidence: The 복각 badge is rendered only in the single-item branch (`group.items[0].is_rerun`); the grouped branch (`isGrouped`, items with the same game/type/dates) renders `[비공식]` per item but never checks `item.is_rerun`.
findings.impact: When two PICKUP schedules of the same game share dates (a common rerun + new banner pairing), the sidebar and mobile drawer hide which one is the rerun.
findings.recommendation: Render the same 복각 badge next to the per-item `[비공식]` badge in the grouped list and cover it with a hero-sidebar test.

findings.evidence: `req.schedule_type === "VERSION" ? "버전" : "픽업"` labels every non-VERSION request as 픽업. This file was not in the Step 2 allowed list (Orchestrator omission).
findings.impact: Users viewing their own request history see BROADCAST (and pre-existing CONTENTS) requests labelled as 픽업, and no 복각 indication.
findings.recommendation: Add this file to the fix iteration scope and use the same four-way label (버전/픽업/콘텐츠/특별방송) plus the 복각 badge.

findings.evidence: Calendar tile banners print the raw English type for VERSION/PICKUP/CONTENTS but the Korean `특별방송` for BROADCAST.
findings.impact: Mixed-language banner labels on the same tile; minor visual inconsistency.
findings.recommendation: Use `BROADCAST` (or a short English label such as `LIVE`) for consistency with the other banners, or localize all four together in a separate change.
